about: Facades read from vector elevations (1:200, so 1 pt = 0.070556 m), by hand: where each drawing's facade sits on the sheet (x of its two ends, the y of one level line and its kote) and where it sits on the site (the two ends of the wall line, from the left end as one stands outside looking at it). tools/elevations.py reads the windows and doors inside 'box' and places them along the wall and in kote. 'skip' cuts out parts of the box drawn in front of the wall (the module). Levels: +23,54 is 3. etasje; checked against +27,76, +32,02, +35,52, +38,38 on the same sheets.
